hero.title: Ibiganiro mu bakozi ku bw'amahoro arama mu kazi.
hero.slogan: « Ibiganiro mu kazi ku bw'amahoro n'iterambere mu gihugu »
hero.description: Urwego ruhuza Leta, Abakoresha hamwe n'Abakozi ku ntego imwe: gushinga no gutsimbataza amahoro arama mu kibanza c'akazi mu Burundi.

tripartite.title: Inzego zitatu zicaye ku meza amwe y'ibiganiro
tripartite.subtitle: Inama igizwe n'abanywanyi 22: abaserukira impande zitatu 21 (7 kuri buri ruhande) hamwe n'Umukuru wigenga umwe.
tripartite.govDesc: Iserukira Leta mu biganiro kandi igakurikirana ishirwa mu ngiro ry'amategeko n'amahoro mu kazi.
tripartite.empDesc: Ivugira abikorera ku giti cabo n'amashirahamwe y'abakoresha mu masezerano n'ibiganiro vy'akazi.
tripartite.traDesc: Iserukira ivyipfuzo n'uburenganzira bw'abakozi bo mu Burundi mu nzego zose z'ibiganiro nserukiragihugu.
tripartite.independent: Bwemeza ubutagiteranyirizwa, ubuhuza no guhuza impande zose uko ari zitatu.

about.title: Urwego rwavutse ku bw'ibiganiro
about.p1: CNDS ni Komite Nserukiragihugu y'Ibiganiro mu Bakozi yashinzwe mu ntumbero yo gutsimbataza amahoro arama mu kazi mu Burundi. Impande zitatu — Leta, Abakoresha, Abakozi — zateye umukono ku Masezerano Nshingiro y'Ibiganiro ku wa 25 Rusama 2011 i Gitega.
about.p2: Ayo masezerano asobanura uburyo ibiganiro mu kazi bigenda mu Burundi kandi yateguye ishingwa rya CNDS biciye mw'itegeko ry'Umukuru w'Igihugu, igizwe n'abaserukira impande zose mu buryo buringaniye.
about.visionText: « Uburundi bufise amahoro arama mu kazi kubera ubufatanye nyakuri bw'impande zitatu ku bw'iterambere n'akazi gateye iteka ».

timeline.title: Ibihe bikuru vy'ishirwaho ry'urwego
timeline.date1Desc: Guterako umukono ku Masezerano Nshingiro y'Ibiganiro i Gitega n'impande zitatu z'ingenzi.
timeline.date2Desc: Itegeko N° 100/47 rishyiraho, rigena abagize n'imikorere ya CNDS.
timeline.date3Desc: Itegeko N° 100/132 rihindura kandi rigakomeza imikorere ya CNDS.
timeline.date4Desc: Itegeko N° 238 rigena Umukuru wa CNDS, hamwe n'Itegeko N° 239 rigena abagize CNDS bose.

bureau.title: Uburongozi Bukuru bwa CNDS
bureau.subtitle: Abayobozi 5 bashinzwe kuyobora no guhagararira ibiganiro mu kazi mu Burundi.
bureau.organ1Desc: Abanywanyi 27 bafata ingingo ku ntumbero zikuru z'igihugu.
bureau.organ2Desc: Abanywanyi 5 bayobora ibikorwa vya buri musi vy'urwego.
bureau.organ3Desc: Utugwi twiga amategeko, ubutunzi n'imibano myiza mu kazi.
bureau.organ4Desc: Ibiro bijejwe ubutegetsi n'ibikorwa by'imisi yose.
